## Summary

Describe the problem and the change in a few sentences.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their result.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated refactoring.
- [ ] I added or updated tests for changed behavior.
- [ ] I updated public documentation when the integration contract changed.
- [ ] I did not add credentials, buyer data, session IDs, Order IDs, seller
  references (including `external_reference`), idempotency keys, or complete
  checkout URLs.
- [ ] I read and follow the repository's Code of Conduct and contribution guide.

## Compatibility and security impact

Describe any API, dependency, migration, or security-boundary impact. State
`None` when there is no impact.
